# Configuration reference

Every file Hecklr reads is validated against these models before anything runs; an unknown key or a wrong type is an error with its file and line. Fields ending in `_env` name the environment variable that holds a secret: secrets never go in these files.

## hecklr.yaml

### HecklrConfig { #hecklrconfig }

Root of `hecklr.yaml`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `1` | required |  |
| `agent` | [AgentConfig](#agentconfig) | required |  |
| `world` | str | required | Path to the world file, relative to `hecklr.yaml`. |
| `suites` | dict[str, [SuiteConfig](#suiteconfig)] | required |  |
| `models` | [ModelsConfig](#modelsconfig) | required |  |
| `stats` | [StatsConfig](#statsconfig) | see its fields |  |
| `budget` | [Budget](#budget) | see its fields |  |
| `baseline` | [BaselineConfig](#baselineconfig) | see its fields |  |
| `gate` | [GateConfig](#gateconfig) | see its fields |  |
| `seed` | int | `0` | Root seed; every trial seed is derived from it. |
| `output_dir` | str | `.hecklr` |  |

| `name` | str | required |  |

### WebSocketVoiceAdapterConfig (`websocket`) { #websocketvoiceadapterconfig }

A voice agent reached over one WebSocket per call.

`protocol` picks the message format:

- `pcm`: binary messages of raw 16-bit little-endian mono PCM at `sample_rate` both
  ways; text messages are JSON control messages (`{"type": "clear"}` from the agent).
- `twilio`: Twilio Media Streams, bidirectional: JSON `connected` / `start` /
  `media` / `stop` with base64 G.711 mu-law at 8 kHz; the agent's `mark` and
  `clear` work as on Twilio. Most telephony-facing agent stacks speak it.
- `pipecat`: Pipecat's `ProtobufFrameSerializer` (its default WebSocket format):
  binary `Frame` messages carrying `AudioRawFrame` audio and `InterruptionFrame`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `websocket` | required |  |
| `url` | str | required |  |
| `protocol` | `pcm` \| `twilio` \| `pipecat` | `pcm` |  |
| `sample_rate` | int \| null |  | Audio rate on the wire; 16 kHz by default, always 8 kHz for `twilio`. |
| `headers` | dict[str, str] |  |  |
| `connect_timeout_s` | float | `10.0` |  |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `cooperativeness` | float | `0.5` |  |

### Behaviors { #behaviors }

Turn-taking behaviors; voice uses all of them, chat and email only the textual ones.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interrupt_prob` | float | `0.0` | Chance per agent turn that the caller barges in. |
| `backchannel_prob` | float | `0.0` | Chance per long agent turn of an "mm-hm" that must not stop the agent. |
| `silence_prob` | float | `0.0` | Chance per caller turn of going quiet for 5-10 s to test re-engagement. |
| `mid_utterance_pause_s` | tuple[float, float] \| null |  | Range of a hesitation inserted mid-utterance, to test premature endpointing. |
| `response_gap_ms` | tuple[int, int] | `[200, 900]` | Range of the pause between agent end-of-speech and the caller's reply. |
| `fillers` | bool | `false` | Whether utterances include fillers such as "uh, hold on". |

## Success criteria

Each entry of a scenario's `success` list is one of these, chosen by its `type`.

### ToolCalledCriterion (`tool_called`) { #toolcalledcriterion }

At least `min_calls` calls to `tool` whose arguments contain `args`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `tool_called` | required |  |
| `tool` | str | required |  |
| `args` | dict[str, JsonValue] |  | Subset match: every listed argument must be present with an equal value. |
| `min_calls` | int | `1` |  |

### ToolNotCalledCriterion (`tool_not_called`) { #toolnotcalledcriterion }

No call to `tool` (optionally: no call whose arguments contain `args`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `tool_not_called` | required |  |
| `tool` | str | required |  |
| `args` | dict[str, JsonValue] |  |  |

### ArgsMatchCriterion (`args_match`) { #argsmatchcriterion }

Every call to `tool` has these exact argument values and regex-matching strings.

Differs from `tool_called`: that asks whether one good call exists, this asks whether all
calls are well-formed (e.g. dates always ISO 8601).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `args_match` | required |  |
| `tool` | str | required |  |
| `args` | dict[str, JsonValue] |  |  |
| `patterns` | dict[str, str] |  | Argument name -> regex that the argument's string form must fully match. |

### CallOrderCriterion (`call_order`) { #callordercriterion }

Tools are called in this order (as a subsequence, or contiguously if `strict`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `call_order` | required |  |
| `tools` | list[str] | required |  |
| `strict` | bool | `false` |  |

### StateCriterion (`state`) { #statecriterion }

A boolean expression over `world` (after), `world_before` and `facts`.

Evaluated with a sandboxed evaluator (simpleeval), never Python `eval`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `state` | required |  |
| `expr` | str | required |  |
| `description` | str \| null |  |  |

| `model` | str \| null |  | Overrides `models.judge` from `hecklr.yaml` for this criterion. |

### LatencyP95BelowCriterion (`latency_p95_below`) { #latencyp95belowcriterion }

95th-percentile agent response latency in the trial is below `ms`.

Chat: time to first token. Voice: end of caller speech to first agent audio frame.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `latency_p95_below` | required |  |
| `ms` | int | required |  |

A voice metric of the trial stays below a threshold (in the metric's own unit).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `voice_metric` | required |  |
| `metric` | `response_latency` \| `barge_in_reaction` \| `false_interruptions` \| `backchannel_robustness` \| `dead_air` \| `talk_over_ratio` | required |  |
| `below` | float | required |  |
| `quantile` | `p50` \| `p95` \| `p99` | `p95` | Used by per-event latency metrics; ignored by rates and counts. |
